assumptions: same cell and co-localized mechanical/electrical measurements
known gate family and sufficiently rich noiseless input curve
positive lambda and k; calibrated physical units for tension observations

hill.qualification: The zero of tension is fixed in this Hill form, so the sigmoid translation gauge does not apply. Structural rank does not guarantee practical estimability near a narrow response range.

latent_linear_mechanics.additional_identifiable_candidate: tau_m under time-resolved, sufficiently varied F(t), absent confounding electrical kinetics

two_stage_linear_dynamics.intermediate_mechanics_transfer: 1/(1+tau_m*s); measuring m breaks label swap if sampling is adequate
two_stage_linear_dynamics.qualification: This is a local linear-cascade example, not proof that every nonlinear Piezo model has the same swap ambiguity.

unrestricted_latent_dynamics.equivalence: For any invertible state transform z=phi(T), use dz/dt=phi'(T)f(T,F) and readout h(phi^-1(z)); F-to-I is unchanged.
unrestricted_latent_dynamics.implication: A flexible NODE latent coordinate has no intrinsic tension unit or molecular interpretation without a measured intermediate or strong physical constraints.

adaptation.qualification: Dynamics may identify recovery parameters only when the protocol varies p and recovery interval; one fixed pulse cannot establish this generically.

voltage_and_count.multiple_voltages: Can identify E and B=N gamma if gating and conductance are voltage-invariant over the tested range

cross_dataset_rule: Observations from different cell types, perturbations or mechanics geometries constrain priors; they do not break a same-cell gauge without justified parameter transport.
